request.description: A section of a dungeon wall seen straight on from the front, filling the frame. Big rough grey stone blocks laid in level courses with deep dark mortar joints between them. A heavy squared timber beam runs horizontally across the wall, bolted flat against the stone with driven iron pins at each end and bound with a turn of rope. Below it a salvaged plank has been pinned across an older repair. The stone is rubbed pale and smooth where shoulders have passed along it, and grimed dark in the joints. Along the very top edge of the wall runs a narrow band of its upper surface, seen from slightly above, so the wall reads as thick. Heavy, over-built and plain: every band and pin is holding something, and nothing on it is decorative.
